# Reservoir pressure from a history-matched model, on a grid (one CSV)

`pressure_grid` · adapter 1.0.0 · makes `reservoir_pressure` tokens

| | |
|---|---|
| Provider | The operator the region names (NAM, through TNO, for Groningen) |
| Home | https://zenodo.org/records/10245813 |
| Licence | `LicenseRef-per-region` |

## Terms

Groningen's pressure model was provided by NAM and published by TNO on Zenodo (record 10245813) as open access with no licence stated. Craton reads it and never redistributes it; cite NAM, TNO and the record.

## Cite

- TNO (2023). Data for TNO Modelchain for Groningen [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.10245813 (files provided by NAM and KNMI)

## Access

One CSV through Zenodo's files API, checked against the record's MD5, downloaded once and cached by hash.

## From the source to the token

| Token slot | Comes from |
|---|---|
| `kind` | `forcing` |
| `lat, lon` | the grid point, converted from the region's `crs` |
| `depth_km` | the reservoir depth the region states (the grid gives none) |
| `time` | the date in the column's header, 00:00 UTC |
| `value` | pressure, converted to MPa |
| `qualifiers` | model, reservoir |

## Uncertainty

Assumed 0.5 MPa: the model is fitted to measured pressures, and its error is not published.

## Known issues

- A model, matched with hindsight: the pressure of 2016 was refitted with the measurements up to 2023. Readers should say so.
- Dates after the model was made (Groningen's grid runs to 2054) are the operator's forecast of its own plans.
- One value per grid point for the whole reservoir thickness; depth is assumed.
